name: Atria 1.4.1 English
author: ren7995
summary: English-only rebuild of the Dopamine-compatible Atria 1.4.1-8 package. Fixes floating-dock compatibility while preserving independent preference control for all dock settings.
tagline: A clean English Home Screen layout editor.
longDescription: English-only Atria rebuild for modern rootless jailbreaks. Customize icon layout, spacing, dock behavior, and Home Screen presentation with independent controls.
changelog: Improved floating-dock compatibility and English preferences.

name: CelcomDigi Compatibility
author: kelvin
summary: Compatibility support for CelcomDigi on the configured device.

name: CleanPicture
author: Kelvin Dass
summary: Camera picture replacement for iOS 17-18.5 with an injected floating selector, multiple images, app scope, editing and enhanced frame replacement.
longDescription: CleanPicture adds a floating camera selector with multiple images, per-app scope, editing tools, and enhanced frame replacement. Choose exactly what appears, where it appears, and change it without leaving your workflow.
changelog: Improved frame replacement and expanded iOS 18.5 support.

name: Complications English for iOS 17
author: Ben Giannis
summary: watchOS-style widgets on the Lock Screen. Includes the ComplicationsFix compatibility hook, English preferences, rootless paths, a rootless respring fix, and arm64/arm64e binaries for modern jailbreaks including iOS 17.
tagline: watchOS-style Lock Screen widgets in English.
longDescription: An English, rootless-compatible build of Complications with modern compatibility hooks, corrected preference paths, and respring support for newer jailbreaks including iOS 17.
changelog: Added modern rootless paths and iOS 17 compatibility fixes.

name: MAE Quick QR
author: Kelvin
summary: One expandable MAE Control Center module for Scan, Receive QR, and Pay QR.
tagline: Your essential MAE QR actions in Control Center.
longDescription: MAE Quick QR combines Scan, Receive QR, and Pay QR inside one expandable Control Center module, giving you instant access to the MAE actions you use most.
